contract: Observed first64 OP timings and first32 FRAME records per case; sizes beyond OP prefix inferred from alternating sequence and frame issue counts.
limits: Prefixes are not representative samples of whole cases.
No IOSB-at-return, device-idle or lower queue occupancy observation exists.
FRAME after_initial counts undelivered fixture callbacks, not native queue depth.
No first512 timed operation is guaranteed; absent groups remain null.
Whole-case first512 count equals pair_split under the frozen strictly alternating issue sequence; this is derived, not a new timing measurement.
No explanation of full-case regressions is proven.
